post_clip.description: At ~46.5s, the person in the yellow shirt suddenly drops/collapses to the floor without any visible physical contact or fall from height; simultaneously, the person in the light blue shirt behind the counter ducks sharply and moves away from the desk—consistent with a sudden threat like gunfire. The man in white at the right counter remains standing but appears alert and tense. No weapon is visible, but the abrupt, unprovoked collapse and reactive ducking strongly suggest a shooting event.
